# Big South Conference baseball awards

The Big South Conference offers multiple annual baseball awards. These awards include the Coach of the Year, the Pitcher of the Year, the Player of the Year, the Freshmen of the year and the Newcomer of the year. The most recent winners are, respectively, Kane Sweeney, Clay Edmondson, Konni Durschlag, Wade Walton and Amp Phillips. The conference also has a yearly All-Big South first team and second team, as well as an All-Academic team.[http://www.bigsouthsports.com/entries/big-south-announces-baseball-annual-award-winners BigSouthSports.com]
